changes: Classic Mac resource forks now sync for on-demand files: old fonts (suitcases, .suit, .fam, FFIL) kept their content in the resource fork with a 0-byte data fork, so it was lost; uploads now pack resource fork + FinderInfo into an AppleDouble blob and unpack on download
Files with both a data fork and a resource fork stay on the plain upload path (no regression)
Server version bumped for parity; no server behaviour change
On-demand sync reliability overhaul (server + client)
